title: Prompt - Complete Customization Guide
body:
&CPROMPT - COMPLETE CUSTOMIZATION GUIDE&x

&WCOMMANDS&x
  prompt                    Show your current format (the actual codes).
  prompt help               Read this complete customization guide.
  prompt default            Restore the full default prompt.
  prompt basic              HP, Chakra and Stamina only.
  prompt biran              Compact colored HP, Chakra, and Stamina bars.
  prompt combat             Resources and your enemy's health percent.
  prompt detailed           Village, rank, level, resources, XP, ryo, MP.
  prompt minimal            Compact resource numbers.
  prompt off                Hide the prompt entirely.
  prompt <format>           Replace it with your own text and tokens.

&WALL WORKING PLACEHOLDERS (case matters)&x
  &RHEALTH&x       %h current HP             %H maximum HP
  &BCHAKRA&x       %c current Chakra         %C maximum Chakra
  &GSTAMINA&x      %s current Stamina        %S maximum Stamina
  &CEXPERIENCE&x   %x current total XP       %X XP needed for next level
               %q XP remaining until the next level
  &YPROGRESSION&x  %l ninja level            %k displayed ninja rank
               %v current village         %p primary class
  &YMONEY&x        %r ryo                    %m mission points
  &WENEMY&x        %e target HP as a percent %n target name
  &WSTAFF ONLY&x   %V current room VNUM (blank for players)
  &WLITERAL&x      %% prints a percent sign (%)

&WRESERVED BUT CURRENTLY BLANK&x
  %t, %a, %d and %E are recognized, but currently show no data.
  They are not active time, alignment, day or effect meters.
  Enemy tokens %e and %n are also blank outside combat.

&WMAKE YOUR OWN PROMPT&x
  Any words, spacing, punctuation, and separators are yours to change.
  Tokens are case-sensitive: %h is current HP, %H is max HP.
  Use &-color codes to color the labels AND numbers. End with &&x.
  A color applies to everything until the next color or &&x reset.
  Lowercase colors are dark; uppercase colors are bright. &w is gray, &W is white.
  For the full palette and 256-color options, type HELP COLORS.

&WEXAMPLES - COPY THESE COMMANDS&x
  Simple:    prompt &&RHP:%h/%H &&BCH:%c/%C &&GST:%s/%S&&x
  Preview:   &RHP:100/120 &BCH:150/200 &GST:75/90&x

  Progress:  prompt &&CLevel %l &&W[%k] &&YXP:%q left &&MRyo:%r&&x
  Preview:   &CLevel 35 &W[Genin] &YXP:250 left &MRyo:1200&x

  Combat:    prompt &&RHP:%h/%H &&GSt:%s/%S &&WTarget:%n %e%%&&x
  Preview:   &RHP:100/120 &GSt:75/90 &WTarget:Bandit 80%&x

  256-color: prompt &&[208]HP:%h/%H &&[39]Chakra:%c/%C&&x
  Preview:   &[208]HP:100/120 &[39]Chakra:150/200&x

&WAVAILABLE PRESETS&x
  default  - &RHP &BChakra &GStamina &CXP &YRyo&x
  basic    - &RHP &BChakra &GStamina&x
  biran    - &w|&RHP&w/&196Max HP&w|&MChakra&w/&mMax Chakra&w|&cStamina&w/&CMax Stamina&w|&x
  combat   - &RHP &BChakra &GStamina &WEnemy %&x
  detailed - &CVillage/Rank/Level &RHP &BChakra &GStamina &CXP &YRyo &MMP&x
  minimal  - &RHP &BChakra &GStamina&x (short format)

&WNOTES&x
  Prompt text and chosen preset are saved with your character.
  PROMPT DEFAULT restores the standard layout; PROMPT OFF hides it.
  PROMPT alone shows the raw format, not a rendered preview.
  PROMPT HELP and HELP PROMPT show the same guide.
  To show a literal & in colored text, type &&&&.
